plans.action: Require adjudicated corroboration from at least three distinct federal districts before any claim that the mechanism occurs market-wide. Until that threshold is met, the study asserts only that the mechanism is alleged across two independent families and adjudicated in at least one case, which is what the evidence supports.

items.planned_changes: Require adjudicated corroboration from at least three distinct federal districts before any claim that the mechanism occurs market-wide. Until that threshold is met, the study asserts only that the mechanism is alleged across two independent families and adjudicated in at least one case, which is what the evidence supports.
items.planned_resolution_evidence: A coverage sweep artefact showing three or more corroborating adjudications across three or more districts, or a recorded decision to hold the narrower claim permanently.
items.root_cause: Adjudicated corroboration reaching the study mechanism was found in one case of sixty-seven, because four conditions must hold at once and RECAP complaint coverage fails in forty-three.

items.planned_changes: This finding is not closable by retrieval and no attempt will be made to close it that way. Instead the bias will be bounded and disclosed: measure RECAP complaint coverage across all decided FCRA cases by district and filing year, publish the coverage rates, and attach a standing limitation to every claim that rests on adjudicated corroboration stating that the adjudicated sample is archive-selected and not representative.
items.planned_resolution_evidence: A published coverage-by-district-and-year measurement, plus the standing limitation recorded in the source reliability assessment so it travels with every downstream claim.
items.root_cause: RECAP document coverage is contributed by volunteers, so which adjudications are reachable is determined by who chose to upload rather than by which cases were decided. The bias is in a third-party archive and is not a defect in this study.
